## Start with the test records.

Begin by stating the advertised specification and then reference the specific test record documenting the failure. This provides a clear link between what was claimed and what was observed. 

*Example:*

"The product was advertised to achieve a sustained data transfer rate of 100 Mbps. Test record #20231027-001 documents a maximum sustained data transfer rate of 65 Mbps."
